question: How does a Slotted-Page architecture organize variable-length records on a 4KB disk page?
category: How does a Slotted-Page architecture organize variable-length records on a 4KB disk page?

options.text: Slots grow forward from page header storing (offset, length) pointers; tuple data grows backward from the end of the page.
B+ Trees store data records exclusively in leaf nodes linked as a doubly-linked list, enabling high fan-out in internal nodes and fast sequential range scans.
The node divides in half; the median key is promoted to the parent node, creating a new level if root splits.
